main.description: Page the moderation label log in seq order. For allowlisted moderation services and enrolled services.

cursor.description: A label seq as a decimal string. The response returns labels with a higher seq.

subjects.description: Only return labels on these subjects. Each item is a record URI in repo form (at://{did}/{collection}/{rkey}) or space form (at:space/{authority}/{type}/{skey}/{author}/{collection}/{rkey}), or an account DID.

cursor.description: Poll again from `cursor`. For a log query, it is the last seq scanned for this request. For a `subjects` query, it is the log head when the page is not full. Otherwise it is the last seq returned. When nothing new exists, it is the input cursor, or "0". A page may hold fewer than `limit` labels, or none, while more remain.
